description: Baseline: hash-chain LZ77, greedy matching, 32KB window
Add LTO, codegen-units=1, panic=abort to release profile
Literal run encoding + compact match format (MAX_MATCH 130). Huge ratio win (0.75→0.43) but total_µs slightly worse due to flush overhead and shorter max match
Reduce MAX_CHAIN from 256 to 64 — 35% faster compression, ratio slightly worse (0.75→0.77)
Reduce MAX_CHAIN from 64 to 32 — another 37% faster, ratio 0.77→0.81
MAX_CHAIN=16 — compress slightly faster but decompress much slower due to worse ratio (0.81→0.87). Net worse.
Use u64 word-at-a-time comparison in match finding — 12% faster compression
Skip hash insertions (every 3rd pos) — worse ratio tanks overall speed. Hash insertion not the bottleneck.
Multiplicative hash (0x1E35A7BD) — better distribution, ~6% faster than shift-XOR
Double quick-reject (byte 0 + best_len) — redundant with hash, adds branch penalty
Unsafe match copy in decompressor — eliminates per-byte bounds checks, ~10% faster overall
4-byte hash (u32 read + multiply) — fewer collisions, better ratio (0.81→0.78) AND 9% faster
Unsafe unchecked hash insertion (get_unchecked_mut) — eliminates bounds checks in hot loop, ~5% faster
Unsafe unchecked access in find_best_match — raw ptr for all data/head/prev accesses, ~1-2% faster
target-cpu=native — no measurable improvement on Apple Silicon
4-byte match encoding (5→4 bytes) — great ratio (0.68) but speed worse. Primary metric is speed.
Batch match output with extend_from_slice — one memcpy instead of 5 pushes, ~11% faster
extend_from_slice for 2-byte literal — no improvement over 2 pushes (within noise)
HASH_BITS 15→14 (smaller table) — more collisions, net slower despite better cache
HASH_BITS 15→16 — fewer collisions but more cache misses, net worse
Only insert first match position — saves hash computation but worse ratio tanks overall speed

Baseline with LibDeflate corpus (2.76MB, 10 files). Already has: MAX_CHAIN=32, 4-byte multiplicative hash, u64 match comparison, unsafe unchecked access, extend_from_slice matches, unsafe decompress copy.
Skip hashing in incompressible regions (miss_streak >= 128) — JPEG 1264→350µs, ~2.5% overall faster
SKIP_THRESHOLD 128→64 — triggers skip too early on semi-compressible data like plrabn12
Non-overlapping match copy with copy_nonoverlapping — faster decompression for large non-overlapping matches
Early termination at match ≥ 32 — extra branch on hot path hurts more than it helps with MAX_CHAIN=32
Fully unsafe decompressor (raw ptr reads) — no improvement, branch prediction already good
Remove output.reserve(length) in decompress — no effect, already pre-allocated
LTO + codegen-units=1 — no measurable improvement on single-crate project
MIN_MATCH 3→4 — same output (3-byte matches already marginal with 5-byte tokens) but slower
Compact multi-tier format (literal runs + 2/3/4-byte matches) — ratio 0.75→0.45 amazing but speed 8% worse
Box<[u32]> instead of Vec<u32> for head/prev — no benefit, possibly worse cache behavior
Skip 2 bytes at a time in incompressible regions — helps JPEG but negligible overall
Raw output pointer with macros — compiler already optimizes push/extend, no improvement
MAX_CHAIN 32→24 — 4.5% faster overall, compress 7% faster, ratio negligibly worse (0.754→0.755)
MAX_CHAIN 24→20 — compress slightly faster but worse ratio makes decompress slower, net worse
WINDOW_SIZE 32K→64K — distance overflow: 65536 wraps to 0 in 2-byte encoding
aarch64 prefetch intrinsic — unstable feature, doesn't compile on stable Rust
Hoist next chain pointer read before comparison — compiler already does this, no benefit
XOR-shift hash — terrible distribution, kennedy.xls doubled in time. Multiplicative hash is far better.
Rep-distance fast path (threshold 8) — kennedy.xls 33% faster but ratio penalty on text files cancels gains
LZ77+Huffman full rewrite — decode table index out of bounds, needs debugging
Compact format: literal runs + 2/3/4-byte matches. Ratio 0.755→0.452 (-40%!). JPEG barely expands (1.007). Speed 13% slower but dramatically better compression.
Refactor decompress: factored copy_match, unsafe tag reads, cleaner structure. ~Same speed.
Lazy matching — ratio 0.451→0.451 (negligible) but compress 55% slower. Double find_best_match too expensive.
MAX_CHAIN 24→32 with compact format — marginal ratio gain (0.4519→0.4516), speed 3.5% worse
Remove output.reserve in copy_match — no effect, already pre-allocated
LZ77+Huffman: ratio 0.452→0.423 (-6.5%). Bitstream encoding of Huffman literals + fixed-width matches. Speed 24% slower — needs optimization.
Bulk 7-byte refill in BitReader — mask computation overhead makes it slower than byte-at-a-time
DEFLATE-style combined lit/len+dist Huffman: ratio 0.423→0.337 (-20%!). kennedy.xls at 0.236. Speed 36% slower — bitstream + dual Huffman trees overhead.
Eager BitReader refill (always fill to 24+ bits) — decompress 26% faster, total 19% faster
4-byte flush in BitWriter — no improvement, compiler already optimizes byte loop
MAX_CHAIN 24→16 with Huffman — compress faster, ratio nearly identical (Huffman compensates for shorter chains)
MAX_CHAIN 16→12 — 6% faster, ratio unchanged (0.3383 vs 0.3378). Huffman compensates well.
MAX_CHAIN 12→8 — another 6% faster, ratio still 0.34. Compress approaching original LZ77 speed.
MAX_CHAIN=6 marginal (24213 vs 24371). MAX_CHAIN=4 worse (25322). MAX_CHAIN=8 is the sweet spot.
Optimal parsing (forward DP): ratio 0.340→0.315 (-7.4%). kennedy.xls 0.236→0.184. Compress 5x slower due to DP over full input — needs block-based processing.
Combined match-finding+DP in single pass — same ratio (0.313), eliminates 11MB temp arrays. Decompress 5.1ms (improved from 6.2ms).
MAX_CHAIN 8→32 with DP — ratio 0.313→0.309 (-1.3%). kennedy.xls 0.179. Compress 66% slower but best ratio yet.
DP with 8 length candidates at DEFLATE boundaries — ratio 0.309→0.308. Marginal win, compress 34% slower.
Iterative DP (2-pass): static prices → Huffman → real prices → final. Ratio 0.308→0.306 (-0.8%). Properly guided DP finds better parse.
12 length candidates in DP — only 0.1% ratio gain for 22% slower compress. 8 points is close to optimal.
MAX_CHAIN=48 and 64 — diminishing returns (0.3054 vs 0.3058). Longer chains not worth the cost with DP.
Explicit RLE (distance=1) in DP — no improvement, hash chain already finds these matches
3-pass iterative DP — 3rd pass adds only 0.02% ratio gain. 2 passes already converge.
Dual-match finder (best + nearest dist<256) — near matches rarely beat longest after price eval. No ratio gain.
64KB window (65535, not power-of-2!) — bitmask broken, cache pressure, ratio worse 0.306→0.311
Block splitting (8K and 64K tokens) — header overhead cancels coding gain. Homogeneous files don't benefit from per-block tables.
Baseline: LZ77+Huffman+DP iterative (12 files, 3.46MB). Target: improve ratio using Brotli/PAQ techniques.
Wave 4 baseline: SA+hash chain, block DP, Huffman/rANS try-both, 9 ctx, 8MB window.
Rep-aware dist freqs between DP passes (replay encoder REP0-3 state) + DP uses learned dist_prices[REP*] instead of hardcoded 2/3/4 bits. 0.220861→0.220661
Lower entropy price floor 1 bit→1/8 bit (clamp 32) — zero effect: last DP pass uses Huffman lengths; only kennedy uses rANS. ratio 0.220661 (unchanged)

LZMA-style adaptive binary range coder backend (12-state, matched literals, REP0-3, LZMA dist slots, lc/lp/pb tried from 8 sets) as 3rd try-all coder, no table header. 0.220661→0.218454 (-1.0%). Wins on plrabn/urls/geo/franko/fields/jpeg; Huffman still wins alice/asyoulik/cp, rANS kennedy.
LZMA backend PROB_BITS 11→12. 0.218454→0.218220
LZMA two-rate counters (avg fast+slow): 4/7→0.218687, 5/6→0.218435, 4/5→0.218359 — all worse than single shift 5 (0.218220)

Refactor DP into dp_parse(Prices) + extra DP pass with LZMA-estimated prices (lc=3 ctx, is_match per ctx, bucketed len prices, slot prices, rep index prices); both parses tried with LZMA backend. 0.218220→0.217503, compress +19%
Second LZMA-priced DP pass, stats re-estimated from 1st LZMA parse. 0.217503→0.217261, compress +11%
Huffman DP passes 4→3 for <500KB (LZMA passes still 2): ratio 0.217291 (worse), compress time unchanged — DP not the bottleneck

LZMA backend literal coding via lpaq-style integer logistic mixer: inputs = LZMA lit prob (incl. matched literal), order-1 full-byte ctr, hashed order-2 ctr, bias; 16 weight sets (bitpos × matched). Decoder normalize if→while (p can reach 1/4096). 0.217261→0.213960 (-1.5%), beats brotli-11 (0.2167) and xz (0.2156). compress +20%, decompress 37→76ms
LZMA param sets 8→4: lc∈{0,1,2,3}, lp=pb=0 (pb/lp never won). 0.213960→0.213954, compress 6.39→5.16s
Literal ctr limit sweep 30/60/127/255/1020 → 1020 best (more stationary). MIX_LR sweep 2/4/6/10/16 → 6 stays best. 0.213954→0.213874
Literal mixer: + hashed order-3 counter input (5 inputs). 0.213874→0.213700. Small files (fields/cp) slightly worse, text better.

LZMA DP passes price literals per position: shadow pass of the adaptive literal mixer over the whole input (trained only on previous parse's literal positions, lc=2, no matched side-info) + per-ctx is_match0 cost. 0.213700→0.209988 (-1.74%). alice 0.318→0.309, plrabn 0.346→0.334. kennedy back to rANS, geo +0.1%. compress +21%
Probe: Huffman-parse stream never wins under LZMA backend, lc=1 never wins → encode only LZMA parse with lc∈{0,2,3}. Ratio unchanged 0.209988, compress 6.28→5.89s
Shadow literal-cost pass uses matched-literal side info (rep0 = dist of previous-parse match ending at i). 0.209988→0.209831. kennedy still rANS (LZMA 48398 vs 48360).
LZMA DP: is_match and rep-index/normal selection prices split by state (prev token literal vs match, from prev_info MSB) like the coder's is_match[state]/is_rep[state]. 0.209831→0.208793 (-0.5%)

APM/SSE after literal mixer, ctx=(prev byte,node), 33 interpolated bins, rate 7, final=(mix+3apm)/4. 0.208793→0.208512. Variant ctx=node only: 0.208599 at same speed → full ctx kept. compress +14%, decompress 108→149ms

LZMA shortrep (is_rep0_long bit + DP option, prior weight on literal==rep0-byte opportunities 0.1/0.3/1.0): 0.208566/0.208605/0.208656, all worse than 0.208512 — matched-literal mixing already covers it; rep0long bit is pure overhead
Mixer weight set = bitpos × matched × confidence(6 buckets from o2/o3 ctr counts: unseen o2, unseen o3, n3<4, <16, <64, ≥64). 0.208512→0.208143, compress +5%
Shadow literal-cost pass lc 2→0 (lc=3: 0.208170). 0.208143→0.208087
Literal mixer: + hashed order-4 ctr (6 inputs). 0.208087→0.207372 (-0.34%). plrabn 0.3291→0.3262, alice 0.3047→0.3034. decompress 210ms

Generic literal mixer: hashed ctx = o2,o3,o4,o6,word (8 inputs); nibble-slotted hashing (16-ctr slot per nibble = 1 cache line; 256-blocks wasted table: 0.2058, per-bit scatter 0.2044 but +69% time). lc trials {0,2} (lc=3 dropped), Huffman seed DP passes 4→2 (LZMA wins everywhere; also better seed). 0.207372→0.204114 (-1.57%). A/B same load: compress 6.50→8.03s (+23.6%), decompress ~0.36s
All LZMA binary probs (is_match, rep flags, len/slot trees, lit): 12-bit p + 4-bit count in u16; shift schedule 2,3,3,4,4,4,5… (fast start), p clamped [31,4065]. 0.204114→0.203881, every file better
Length coders (match & rep) get context = bucket(prev match length: <4,<8,<16,≥16) via pos_state slot (pb=0 always). kennedy 47251→40142 (-15%). 0.203881→0.201847 (-1.0%)
is_match ctx = state × (prev byte >> 5) (matches DP pricing ctx). 0.201847→0.200138 (-0.85%); berkut -2.8%, alice -0.9%
Distance slot tree ctx: × (prev byte>>5) → 0.200303; × (state≥7) → 0.200218; both worse than 0.200138 (dilution)
Rep flags is_rep/g0/g1/g2 ctx = state × prev-length bucket. kennedy 39684→39139. 0.200138→0.199983 (first < 0.2)
